string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_3_1
string.value: Added YouTube SABR/UMP streaming support, improving compatibility for new-format, high-resolution, and restricted videos

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_3_2
string.value: Refactored video extraction and client selection, aligned with PipePipe request behavior, restored remote signature decryption, reduced duplicate extraction and startup wait

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_3_3
string.value: Improved local DASH media proxy: separated A/V tracks, segmented cache, precise seeking, stream break recovery, and playback end handling

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_3_4
string.value: Added SABR PoToken support; optimized signature parameters, request headers, and binary response handling, reducing 403 / unable to play / loading failures

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_3_5
string.value: Improved player state sync, quality and audio track switching, fixed endless loading after playback, seek offset and audio track menu issues

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_3_6
string.value: Upgraded playlist parsing and pagination, compatible with new list structures, locked content, and continuation; improved list loading and continuous playback

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_3_7
string.value: Reorganized account and data management entry, improved linkage between sign-in state, watch history, local page, download options, and playback preferences

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_3_8
string.value: Improved home recommendations, video cards, theme color, picture-in-picture, and system media session; fixed multiple UI and playback stability issues

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_2_1
string.value: Player page adds Audio-only: turn off video and listen to sound, cover replaces picture, progress and controls still available

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_2_2
string.value: In audio-only mode, no picture-in-picture; returning to foreground keeps audio-only, manual resume required

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_2_3
string.value: Background can delay turning off video to save power (adjustable in playback settings)

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_2_4
string.value: Fixed system broadcast interruption: correct duck volume reduction, avoid secondary compression causing silence

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_2_5
string.value: Smoother landscape/portrait, fullscreen, and windowed playback, reduced screen black and blur

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_2_6
string.value: Home page after login better matches account state, can sync cloud watch history and subscriptions

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_2_7
string.value: Clearer video cards, live badges, and page safe area display

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_2_8
string.value: Support app handoff and tap-to-share video links

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_1_3
string.value: Fixed inability to watch after login

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_1_4
string.value: Fixed information bar popping up incorrectly in landscape mode

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_1_6
string.value: Completed local decryption logic verification, ready for deployment

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_0_1
string.value: Replaced system playback engine and third-party FFMpeg with MPVPlayer

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_0_2
string.value: Restored high-resolution playback and subtitle features

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_0_3
string.value: Support HEVC/H.264 hardware decoding; on API 23+ try VP9/AV1 hardware decoding

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_0_5
string.value: Optimized network transport library capabilities in non-login state
